company.shortDescription: Vault Hill is a technology company that develops metaverse, virtual reality, AI, blockchain, and digital asset platforms.
company.description: Vault Hill is a technology company that focuses on extended reality (XR), blockchain, artificial intelligence, and metaverse-related platforms. The company develops products including Vault Hill City, a virtual world platform for digital interaction and virtual land ownership, and Hillda, an AI-based digital assistant platform. Its ecosystem also includes blockchain-based utility and virtual land tokens used for transactions, governance, and digital asset activities within its platforms.
